OF-017 (P1, INHERENT -- not closed by FOUND-006): under the PostgREST shared-login model every API session authenticates as `authenticator`, which Supabase grants membership of both `authenticated` and `service_role`. SET ROLE is authorised against session_user, so a caller with arbitrary SQL as `authenticated` can `set role service_role` and reach every service-only entrypoint. No in-database control can close this while the login role holds both memberships; it requires a separate connection identity for service work, which is an owner infrastructure decision.

OF-014 residual (P1): a caller with arbitrary SQL as the `authenticated` DB role can forge request.jwt.claims — reading one quotation status per id, and more broadly forging `sub` and so auth.uid(). The unauthenticated half is closed. Belongs to FOUND-006.
OF-015 (P2): sections 3 and 6 have no re-runnable schema-level end-to-end discrimination, because they are application code.
